hero_asset_rules.panorama_display_rule: CRITICAL: Panorama must be rendered with object-contain / full aspect ratio preservation. DO NOT crop, distort, blur, zoom, or obscure Cathedral dome and Palazzo Trigona (7 windows). Display full panorama cleanly alongside the mosaic on the right.
hero_asset_rules.mosaic_display_rule: Mosaic must be displayed on the right side of the hero showcase section, crisp, fully visible, circular/medallion bordered with a subtle glowing gold accent ring.

layout_strategy.header: Sticky glassmorphism nav with logo SVG (cathedral dome icon + gold serif typography), language selector dropdown (IT, EN, DE, FR, ES), quick links, CTA button.
layout_strategy.hero_section: Two-column or stacked showcase: Left column contains the full uncropped panorama photo in a refined gold-bordered frame with object-contain. Right column showcases the Villa Romana mosaic medallion with warm ambient lighting. Below/above: Title 'Piazza Armerina' with cursive tagline 'Un'esperienza che ti resta nel cuore'.
layout_strategy.marquee: Slow editorial text ribbon drifting horizontally with low contrast gold/cream lettering and serif separators.
layout_strategy.navigation_grid: 3x3 responsive bento grid of typography and icon-driven cards (01 to 09) featuring thin gold borders, subtle ambient hover glows, indices in gold numerals, interactive detail modals/drawers when clicked.
layout_strategy.interactive_modal: Clicking any navigation card opens an interactive drawer or modal with rich details, historical facts, and key visitor info in the selected language.
layout_strategy.footer: High density dark luxury footer with large bold serif logo, language switch links, quick contact info (graphics only), map info, shuttle schedules.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_rule: MUST add data-testid to every interactive button, tab, card, language switcher, modal close, and link using kebab-case e.g. data-testid='lang-switcher-it', data-testid='hero-explore-btn', data-testid='nav-card-villa'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.responsive_rule: Ensure mobile-first grid, card paddings p-6 to p-8, no overflowing text. Panorama image must render fully visible at all screen sizes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.motion_rule: Use framer-motion for fade-in reveals, staggered cards animation, modal transitions. Smooth scrolling using Lenis logic or standard CSS scroll-behavior.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_overlays: Never use pure transparent backgrounds under text or dropdowns; always use heavy glassmorphism or dark warm solid background.
